notes.title: Patch 1.03 is live!
notes.content:
This is just a simple fix for a bug that was recently brought to our attention:

- Fixed a bug involving a certain Memory being unusable during the final area.

This issue will still affect save data from previous versions if it was made between unlocking and completing the game's final area on the initial playthrough.  In such a case, the issue will correct itself upon reaching the post-game area.

tags.bug: - Fixed a bug involving a certain Memory being unusable during the final area.

notes.title: V1.02 is LIVE!
notes.content:
V1.02 Patch Notes:
- Added support for new screen resolution sizes, for those who prefer a larger window.  Activate with F6.
- Added support for a new fullscreen mode that works together with the new resolutions.  Activate with F5.
- Rewrote and added to early tutorial messages for greater clarity.  Yes, this game does in fact support gamepads!

notes.title: HAPPY NEW YEAR!! Patch 1.01 is now live.
notes.content:
Hope everyone's new year is getting off to a great start! Here's our first patch to a fix a few bugs from the release version.

Patch 1.01 Notes:
- Fixed a bug wherein obstacles involved in recruiting the Sincere Memory would reappear during Plus Mode, blocking access to a certain lexicon entry.
- Fixed a bug wherein rapidly pressing the confirmation button after infusing a memory into a window would cause Schorl to enter the window without playing the appropriate animation.
- Added a version number to the Title Screen.  (This patch is 1.01)
